nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
An extraordinarily beautiful, photorealistic Amazon warrior queen standing tall and confidently on a colossal futuristic rocket launch platform at night. She is a breathtakingly attractive adult woman with a statuesque, athletic hourglass figure, long elegant legs, a graceful waist, strong feminine shoulders, and a commanding royal presence. Her beauty combines the elegance of a queen with the strength of a legendary warrior. She has a beautifully proportioned face, expressive almond-shaped eyes, high cheekbones, naturally full lips, a refined nose, flawless yet realistic skin, and a confident, captivating expression. Her long, thick, dark hair is intricately braided into an elaborate warrior hairstyle, with several loose strands flowing dramatically in the wind generated by the rocket engines.

She wears magnificent gold and bronze futuristic battle armor, exquisitely crafted to complement her athletic feminine physique while providing practical protection. The armor features sculpted gold breastplate contours, elegant engraved ancient motifs, intricate filigree, polished bronze shoulder guards, articulated forearm bracers, an ornate armored waist belt, sculpted thigh guards, and elegant knee-high armored boots. Every piece combines ancient Amazonian royal craftsmanship with advanced aerospace engineering. The metallic surfaces feature intricate geometric engravings, subtle battle-worn details, delicate gold inlays, and realistic reflections. A brilliant blue energy core glows at the center of her chest, casting a subtle sapphire-blue illumination across the surrounding gold armor.

A magnificent flowing crimson cape billows behind her in the powerful night wind, its rich red fabric catching the golden light of the launch platform. An elegant, technologically advanced energy spear rests firmly in her right hand, featuring a beautifully engineered metallic shaft and a luminous blue energy blade. Her left hand rests confidently beside her armored waist. Her posture is tall, poised, and commanding, with squared shoulders, her chin slightly raised, and her gaze fixed toward the distant horizon. She radiates intelligence, courage, authority, feminine elegance, and the unmistakable presence of a legendary warrior queen.

Behind her stands an enormous next-generation rocket, towering into the night sky beneath brilliant industrial floodlights. The rocket’s immense white and metallic body rises above a complex launch gantry filled with sophisticated machinery, illuminated maintenance platforms, robotic service arms, and advanced aerospace equipment. Subtle blue holographic displays float beside the launch structure, displaying orbital trajectories, spacecraft telemetry, and futuristic engineering schematics. Small autonomous drones hover around the gantry, their navigation lights glowing through the atmospheric haze.

Powerful rocket exhaust illuminates the distant launch complex with warm amber light, while cool blue light from the energy core and holographic interfaces creates a striking contrast against the gold armor and crimson cape. Atmospheric vapor drifts across the platform, illuminated by dramatic beams of light. The metal floor reflects the surrounding lights naturally, grounding the scene in a physically believable environment.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: Epic cinematic low-angle full-body composition, the camera positioned slightly below the warrior queen to emphasize her height, beauty, and authority. Her entire body, including her armored boots, remains visible in the frame. She occupies the visual center and is the unmistakable focal point. Her face is clearly visible and beautifully illuminated, with realistic facial proportions and natural skin texture. The towering rocket rises behind her, reinforcing the immense scale of the scene without obscuring her silhouette.

Photographed as an extraordinarily expensive live-action science-fiction film production using a professional full-frame cinema camera, 50mm anamorphic lens, physically accurate golden metallic reflections, realistic fabric movement, intricate armor craftsmanship, lifelike human anatomy, natural skin texture, detailed individual hair strands, cinematic depth, volumetric atmospheric lighting, dramatic but balanced highlights, rich crimson and antique-gold color grading, deep midnight-blue shadows, extraordinary environmental detail, convincing photographic realism.

The final image should resemble an iconic theatrical film poster featuring a breathtakingly beautiful, powerful Amazon warrior queen at the height of her glory. Her beauty must feel natural and human, her armor luxurious and technologically advanced, and the entire scene monumental, elegant, dramatic, and visually unforgettable.
